site.name: PawPulse
site.tagline: The Science-Backed Pet Care & Species Wisdom Network
site.description: Authoritative veterinary-reviewed pet care guides, species behavior insights, step-by-step training manuals, and inspiring stories for dogs, cats, birds, lizards, snakes, small animals, and aquatics.
site.authorDefault: Dr. Julian Vance, DVM & Veterinary Behaviorist

categories.name: Cats & Felines
categories.description: Feline behavioral science, sleep & dreaming twitch analysis, step-by-step gentle nail clipping, litter box psychology, and life-stage nutrition.

categories.name: Dogs & Canines
categories.description: Canine cognitive development, zoomies deciphered, separation anxiety resolution, leash reactive rehabilitation, and bloat prevention protocols.

categories.name: Birds & Parrots
categories.description: Avian psychology, parrot screaming reduction, feather plucking etiology, cage enrichment, UV requirements, and household toxic avoidance.

categories.name: Lizards & Reptiles
categories.description: Bearded dragon brumation cycles, leopard gecko tail drop biology, UVB Ferguson zones, humidity gradients, and terrarium environmental design.

categories.name: Snakes & Serpents
categories.description: Ball python feeding strike recovery, corn snake shedding trouble fixes, temperature microclimates, and low-stress handling methodologies.

categories.name: Small Pets & Mammals
categories.description: Rabbit GI stasis emergency identification, guinea pig vitamin C synthesis, Syrian hamster burrow dynamics, and ferret enrichment systems.

categories.name: Aquatics & Amphibians
categories.description: Nitrogen cycling mastery, betta fin rot therapeutic treatments, axolotl water cooling mechanics, and planted aquarium nutrient balancing.
